name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by his grandfather's stories of rally racing in the Highlands. He pursued a vocational degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in precision machining. His entry into the field was marked by a dedication to understanding the 'why' behind every component, not just the 'how'. He believes in a holistic approach, understanding how each part contributes to the overall performance of the vehicle.

Alistair's approach to machining is rooted in precision and problem-solving. He's not content with simply following instructions; he seeks to improve designs and processes. While relatively new to the professional racing scene, his enthusiasm and drive to innovate make him a valuable asset to any team looking for a machinist with a long-term vision. He's eager to learn from experienced professionals and contribute to the pursuit of racing excellence. 

What sets Alistair apart is his ability to see the bigger picture. He understands that even the smallest component can have a significant impact on performance, and he is always looking for ways to optimize designs and processes to achieve the best possible results. He's particularly interested in exploring the application of new materials and manufacturing techniques to improve the performance and reliability of racing vehicles.
